description: Test suite for helper functions in completion-fish module, verifying escape and build functions for command-line completion lines.

methods.name: escapeFishDescription
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in descriptions for Fish shell completion scripts.

methods.name: buildFishSubcommandCompletionLine
methods.description: Builds a Fish shell completion line for subcommands with description.

methods.name: buildFishOptionCompletionLine
methods.description: Builds a Fish shell completion line for command options with flags and description.

calls: buildFishSubcommandCompletionLine({ rootCmd: "openclaw", condition: "__fish_use_subcommand", name: "plugins", description: "Manage Bob's plugins" })
buildFishOptionCompletionLine({ rootCmd: "openclaw", condition: "__fish_use_subcommand", flags: "-s, --shell <shell>", description: "Shell target" })
buildFishOptionCompletionLine({ rootCmd: "openclaw", condition: "__fish_seen_subcommand_from completion", flags: "--write-state", description: "Write cache" })
